To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) RNN-based MLMs can be trained on symbolic music data and can be used to improve automatic transcription performance, (2) RNN-based models can be used to generate prior probability for the sequence of notes and (3) the use of the prior probability can improve automatic transcription performance.
RNNs are a suitable choice for modeling the temporal structure of symbolic music data and that using an RNN-based music language model improves the performance of automatic music transcription.
RNN-based MLMs can be used to improve the performance of an acoustic AMT system by 3% in terms of F-measure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of RNN-based MLMs for improving the accuracy of polyphonic AMT.
the use of RNNs to model music, and the use of the music models to improve the performance of AMT.
investigating how the use of a prior probability distribution of symbolic music sequences can help to improve AMT performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RNN-based MLMs are capable of capturing the complex temporal structure in symbolic music, and the use of the prior information from MLMs improves the AMT performance.
the proposed method is able to achieve state-of-the-art performance in automatic music transcription.
the use of an RNN-based MusicLM in the hybrid model has a positive effect on AMT performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to build a hybrid model for automatic music transcription that incorporates a music language model into a standard automatic music transcription model.
we were able to show that a hybrid model of acoustic model and music language model is better than using an acoustic model alone.
we were able to improve AMT accuracy by incorporating a prior probability from an RNN-based MLM into the transcription process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of RNNbased MLMs can be a useful tool for improving AMT performance.
the MLMs can be used to generate a prior distribution for music, and this can be integrated into the acoustic AMT model to achieve improved performance.
